Download files from the UCDP replication archive

Source: R/archive.R
ucdp_replication_download.Rd

Download files from the UCDP replication archive

Usage

ucdp_replication_download(
  dataset,
  version = NULL,
  year = NULL,
  type = "data",
  query = NULL,
  variant = NULL,
  download_all = FALSE,
  dest_dir = "replication",
  overwrite = FALSE,
  quiet = FALSE,
  catalog = NULL
)

Arguments

dataset

Dataset name, alias, or regular expression.

version

Optional exact dataset version.

year

Optional publication year or years.

type

File type to select. Defaults to frozen data files.

query

Optional additional regular expression matched by ucdp_replication_catalog().

variant

Optional regular expression matched against artifact titles.

download_all

Download every match? Otherwise ambiguous requests fail.

dest_dir

Destination directory.

overwrite

Replace existing files?

quiet

Suppress messages?

catalog

Optional pre-fetched replication catalog.

Value

A normalized character vector of downloaded paths, invisibly, with catalog records, checksums, retrieval time, and package version attached.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ucdp_replication_download("ged", version = "25.1")
} # }
